dedupe_keys.name: illicit drugs in wastewater score initiative dataset 2011 2017

description: This dataset holds the results of the SCORE (Sewage analysis CORe group Europe) multi-city campaigns, in which members and partners measured five illicit drug residues in wastewater for one week every year from 2011 to 2017. It covers 143 wastewater treatment plants in 120 cities from 37 countries, each monitored at least once, and reports population-normalised loads. The dataset was deposited in 2019 by Christoph Ort (Eawag), Miren López de Alda (IDAEA-CSIC) and Ettore Zuccato and is openly available on DIGITAL.CSIC and on Eawag's open data portal. Caveats: it is a static archive ending in 2017, each city contributes only one week per year, the population estimates behind the normalisation come from each plant, and later campaigns are published elsewhere. Simulation uses: city-level consumption signals measured at treatment-plant inlets, useful to test wastewater-based epidemiology methods and plant catchment population estimates. Related record: the Catalan SARS-CoV-2 sewage network (data-catalan-sarsaigua-wastewater-surveillance), another plant-level wastewater epidemiology dataset.
licence: open access (licence not named on the record page)
name: Illicit drugs in wastewater, SCORE initiative dataset (2011-2017)
notes: The five drugs are not named on the record page (the campaigns usually report amphetamine, methamphetamine, MDMA, cocaine via benzoylecgonine and cannabis via THC-COOH; assistant recall, not checked). Plos figshare 'wastewater drug loads for 42 European cities' is an earlier single-campaign table and was rejected as covered.
